comments.body: I'd say it's possible, it's all a question of priorities. The gym is on campus which is ideal, it's also included in the tuition. You can just take an hour in between studying and come back. However in terms of social life if you want that typical fun student life, then ETH might not be the place. The workload is a lot and the exams in the summer are in August, meaning you'll study the whole summer while your friends at other universities are on vacation. I don't know how it is at TUM, but I think this is something you should consider.
